title: Root-cause & remediation plan for cross-deployment token accounting variance (hosted/dedicated/private)
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Summary: Multiple customers (mid-market and enterprise) reported discrepancies between usage shown in the Console and their invoices: token counts in billing reports are higher than expected (up to +27%) for a subset of requests. The variance appears across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments but with different failure modes. This ticket drives the RCA, immediate mitigations, automated reconciliation, and billing credit pipeline.
comments: 2026-03-10 Sofia Martinez: Initial triage from Support — 3 separate escalations opened today. Slack thread #billing-escalations. Early pattern: customers using streaming + function calls or large-context chat show larger deltas. Opening RCA ticket and paging runtime oncall.

2026-03-10 Arjun Patel: Collected example payloads and billing rows from three customers (IDs: cust-bleu, cust-sierra, cust-zen). Dumped token logs from hosted-metering service and compared with Console aggregates. Noted that hosted-metering.request_tokens != billing_aggregator.token_sum for ~4% of rows where streaming chunk finalization retries occurred.

2026-03-11 Lina Chen (Infra): Observed duplicated accounting events emitted by telemetry-forwarder when gRPC stream reconnects during streaming responses. In Dedicated, an additional path in the private forwarder was double-counting on KV cache refill errors. Hypothesis: reconnect + chunk-replay triggers duplicate token events that the billing-aggregator doesn't dedupe when event_id is missing.
2026-03-11 PM triage (Evan Kim): Prioritize P0 — customer refunds/credits may be necessary. Notify Finance and Sales Ops. Draft customer-facing note with apology and timeline (shared with Legal).

2026-03-12 Arjun: Reproduce plan recorded in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/BILL/ENG-8732+Token+Accounting+RCA. Repro steps for hosted: run streaming generation with simulated network flaps; observe duplicate accounting events in telemetry. For private: run on-prem forwarder with disabled event dedupe setting and simulate KV cache eviction.
2026-03-12 QA (Maria Lopes): Built unit test for telemetry-forwarder to assert idempotency on stream reconnects. Add integration test that replays socket disconnects.
2026-03-12 Arjun: Hotfix branch created (github.com/redwood-inference/runtime PR #1638) to add event_id propagation and aggregator-side idempotency check. Canary patch built for runtime-1.24-canary.

2026-03-13 Ops (Jamal Osei): Canary rollout scheduled: 5% hosted pods in us-west1 and two dedicated pools (cust-sierra, internal-sim). Observability dashboards instrumented: billing.token_gap_by_deployment, telemetry.duplicate_event_rate. Alert thresholds set and runbook updated.

2026-03-13 Finance (Priya Rao): Drafted preliminary refund calculation script to credit invoices where overbilling confirmed. Coordination point: credit amounts must be verified against final reconciled delta and approved by Revenue Ops before applying.

2026-03-13 Arjun: Noted edge-case where tokenization change across model versions (v1.3 -> v1.4) coupled with cached truncated prompts caused per-request token attribution to shift. Adding model-version tag to accounting events to facilitate reconciliation.
2026-03-13 Support (Olivia Park): Customer comms template ready. We will message impacted customers with explanation, interim credit offer, and ETA for full reconciliation (target 2026-03-20).
work_items: Instrument and enforce event_id on telemetry-forwarder for all stream events (hosted/dedicated/private)
Add aggregator-side idempotency: persist last-seen event_id per request_key with TTL to dedupe duplicates
Add model_version tag to accounting events; backfill mapping for last 30 days for reconciliation
Deploy runtime-1.24 hotfix canary -> 100% with staged rollout across hosted regions and dedicated pools
Reconcile invoices for impacted customers and apply credits pending Revenue Ops approval
Postmortem and follow-ups: test suite for reconnect-induced duplicates, billing QA runbook, redact sensitive logs in public postmortem
mitigation_steps: 1) Immediate: Enable aggregator idempotency flag in staging and run local replay against captured events (done)
2) Short-term: Canary deploy PR #1638 to hosted canaries and two dedicated pools (in progress)
3) Customer-facing: Offer provisional credits and provide interim reporting exports for affected customers (Support & Finance)
4) Monitoring: Add Grafana dashboards and high-priority alert for duplicate_event_rate > 0.5%
5) Long-term: Harden telemetry protocol to include event_id and model_version for all metering events and add e2e billing QA before releases
postmortem_notes: Root cause (current hypothesis): race between streaming reconnect logic and telemetry-forwarder that caused duplicate emission of token accounting events without stable event_id. In Dedicated/Private, an additional code path that replays chunks during KV cache refills produced extra accounted tokens.

Why it escaped testing: reconnect scenarios and replay logic live in integration surface not covered by unit tests; billing QA did not replay at-scale streaming reconnects against aggregator idempotency checks.
Corrective actions: telemetry protocol changes, aggregator idempotency, expanded regression tests, customer reconciliation process.
